text:
davide: Customer AcmeGrok reports SSE streams that stop after ~90s idle. Client reconnects repeatedly and they saw a billing spike. Repro + logs below.

tia: Can you paste the SDK logs and the customer load-balancer type?

davide: They have an NLB in front of our dedicated endpoint. SDK logs: 
```
[2026-02-28T14:02:11Z] sse: connected session=abc
[2026-02-28T14:03:45Z] sse: no data for 93s, socket close?
[2026-02-28T14:03:45Z] sse: reconnect attempt 1
[2026-02-28T14:03:46Z] sse: got partial chunk len=18
[2026-02-28T14:03:46Z] sse: stream closed unexpectedly
```

Repro curl: 
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://dedicated-1.redwood.example/v1/stream?session=abc"
```

tcpdump (client side): 
```
14:03:45.123 IP client > nlb: TCP FIN, seq 12345
14:03:45.125 IP nlb > client: TCP RST
```

cheng: That looks like the NLB is TCP-closing after idle probe; we often see RSTs instead of FINs which leaves the server-side connection in half-close/idle. If the client reconnects quickly the runtime may still be processing and return a small leftover chunk then drop. This explains partial outputs and duplicate billing.

opsbot: Incident INC-4321 created for AcmeGrok streaming noise. Priority: P2.

tia: Action items for support: 1) Ask customer to set NLB idle timeout > 300s (or mirror client heartbeat interval), 2) Enable SDK heartbeats (send a ":noop" SSE comment every 30s) 3) Patch SDK to exponential backoff + dedupe token so reconnects aren't charged twice.

cheng: Quick config tips to share with customers: 
nginx proxy: 
```
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_http_version 1.1;
proxy_set_header Connection "";
proxy_send_timeout 3600s;
proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
chunked_transfer_encoding on;
```
envoy snippet: 
```
per_try_idle_timeout: 0s
idle_timeout: 0s
access_log: /dev/stdout
```

Note: for AWS NLB you can't set HTTP keepalives at L4; configure client side keepalives and consider ALB if you need layer7 idle tuning.

davide: Customer applied SDK heartbeat + backoff and increased NLB idle to 400s. Reconnects dropped from ~40/min to 2/min and billing normalized :thumbsup:. Still seeing an occasional tail where the runtime doesn't detect half-close. Escalating to eng-runtime to emit a metric for suppressed keepalives and to add a fast-path close on RST detection.

tia: I'll create a KB article with: repro curl, tcpdump example, nginx/envoy snippets, recommended NLB/ALB guidance, and an SDK patch note. Support playbook will include triage checklist and exact wording to ask customers.

support: Thx team — please paste final KB link here when ready.
